questions.question: Amit purchases an old scooter for ₹5,600. He spends ₹1,400 on its repairs and sells it to Sumit for ₹7,700. Find the profit percentage of Amit.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 5600 + 1400 = 7000

SP = 7700

Profit = 7700 − 7000 = 700

Profit % = (700/7000) × 100

**∴ Answer = 10%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Purchase price = ₹5600, Repair cost = ₹1400, Selling price = ₹7700

**Formula used:**

Total CP = Purchase price + Additional cost

Profit % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total CP = 5600 + 1400 = 7000

⇒ SP = 7700

⇒ Profit = 7700 − 7000 = 700

⇒ Profit % = (700 / 7000) × 100

⇒ = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price Concept

Total CP includes all additional expenses like repairs, transport, etc.

Profit Formula

Profit = SP − CP

Profit Percentage

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

Shortcut Tip

Always include extra costs in CP before calculating profit

questions.question: Solve : 3 × (10 × ( 2² )) ÷ 20 + 13 − 3
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Start from inner bracket: 2² = 4

Expression becomes: 3 × (10 × 4) ÷ 20 + 13 − 3

10 × 4 = 40 ⇒ 3 × 40 ÷ 20

120 ÷ 20 = 6 ⇒ 6 + 13 − 3

**∴ Answer = 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

3 × (10 × (2²)) ÷ 20 + 13 − 3

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3 × (10 × 4) ÷ 20 + 13 − 3

⇒ 3 × 40 ÷ 20 + 13 − 3

⇒ 120 ÷ 20 + 13 − 3

⇒ 6 + 13 − 3

⇒ 19 − 3

⇒ 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Brackets → Orders → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction

Order of Operations

Solve brackets first, then powers, then × and ÷, then + and −

Simplification Tip

Always simplify inner brackets first to reduce steps

Exponent Rule

a² = a × a

questions.question: In an election, there are three candidates: A, B, and C. Candidate A gets 40% of the total valid votes, Candidate B gets 30%, and Candidate C gets the remaining votes. If 12% of the total votes were declared invalid and the total number of voters was 25,000, find the number of votes received by Candidate C.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Valid votes = 88% of 25000 = 22000

A + B = 40% + 30% = 70%

C = 30% of valid votes

Votes for C = 30% of 22000

**∴ Answer = 6600**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 25000, Invalid votes = 12%

A = 40%, B = 30%, C = remaining

**Formula used:**

Valid votes = Total × (1 − invalid%)

Percentage = (Part / Total) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Valid votes = 25000 × 0.88 = 22000

⇒ Votes for A = 40% of 22000 = 8800

⇒ Votes for B = 30% of 22000 = 6600

⇒ Remaining % for C = 100 − (40 + 30) = 30%

⇒ Votes for C = 30% of 22000 = 6600

**∴ The correct answer is 6600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Valid Votes Concept

Valid votes = Total votes − Invalid votes

Percentage Distribution

Total percentage always equals 100%

Remaining Percentage

Remaining = 100 − sum of known percentages

Quick Trick

Find valid votes first, then apply percentages

questions.question: A cricketer has an average of 54 runs for 9 innings. In the 10th inning, he scores 191 runs. By how many runs did his average increase? (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old total = 54 × 9 = 486

New total = 486 + 191 = 677

New average = 677 ÷ 10 = 67.7

Increase = 67.7 − 54 = 13.7 ≈ 14

**∴ Answer = 14 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average for 9 innings = 54, Runs in 10th inning = 191

**Formula used:**

Total runs = Average × Number of innings

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 9 innings = 54 × 9 = 486

⇒ Total runs in 10 innings = 486 + 191 = 677

⇒ New average = 677 ÷ 10 = 67.7

⇒ Increase in average = 67.7 − 54 = 13.7

⇒ Rounded value = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of observations

Total from Average

Total = Average × Number

Effect of New Value

Adding a large value increases average significantly

Rounding Rule

Round to nearest whole number as required

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 80 cm, 44 cm, and 52 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 44 cm?
questions.solution:

Use Heron’s formula shortcut for area

s = (80 + 44 + 52) ÷ 2 = 88

Area = √[88(88−80)(88−44)(88−52)] = √(88 × 8 × 44 × 36)

Area = √(256 × 9 × 121 × 4) = 16 × 3 × 11 × 2 = 1056

Altitude = (2 × Area) ÷ base = (2 × 1056) ÷ 44 = 48

**∴ Answer = 48 cm**

questions.question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 35 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 36 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:

Total age of 31 students = 31 × 35 = 1085

Total age of 32 people = 32 × 36 = 1152

Teacher’s age = 1152 − 1085

= 67

**∴ Answer = 67 years**

Average of 31 students = 35 years

Average of 32 people (including teacher) = 36 years

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of students = 31 × 35 = 1085

⇒ Total age including teacher = 32 × 36 = 1152

⇒ Teacher’s age = 1152 − 1085 = 67

**∴ The correct answer is 67 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average = Total ÷ Number

Total from Average

Total = Average × Number

Extra person adds extra total = difference of totals

Teacher’s age = increase in total sum

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,800 at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the multiplying factor method for 20% compound interest:

Multiplying factor for 1 year = 100% + 20% = 120% = 6 ÷ 5

Amount after 2 years = Principal × (6 ÷ 5) × (6 ÷ 5)

Amount = 2800 × (36 ÷ 25) = 112 × 36 = ₹4032

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,032.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Principal (P) = ₹2800

Rate (R) = 20% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

 Compound Interest Progression

 
•

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 2800 × (1 + 20 ÷ 100)²

⇒ A = 2800 × (1 + 1 ÷ 5)²

⇒ A = 2800 × (6 ÷ 5)²

⇒ A = 2800 × (36 ÷ 25)

Effective Rate Method

For a 2-year period at rate R%, the effective compound interest rate is calculated as: Effective Rate = 2R + (R² ÷ 100)%.

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate becomes half (R ÷ 2) and the time period is doubled (2n).

Difference Between CI and SI

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years on a certain principal P is given by: Difference = P(R ÷ 100)².

questions.question: Evaluate: frac{sec 33circ}{{cosec } 57circ} + sqrt{3} cot 13circ cot 21circ cot 60circ cot 69circ cot 77circ - 2(sin² 41circ + sin² 49circ)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use complementary angles: sin(90 − θ) = cosθ, cot(90 − θ) = tanθ

sec33 / cosec57 = (1/cos33) / (1/sin57) = sin57 / cos33 = 1

cot13 × cot77 = cot13 × tan13 = 1 and cot21 × cot69 = cot21 × tan21 = 1

So middle term = √3 × 1 × 1 × cot60 = √3 × (1/√3) = 1

sin²41 + sin²49 = sin²41 + cos²41 = 1 ⇒ −2 × 1 = −2

**∴ Answer = 1 + 1 − 2 = 0**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sec33° / cosec57° + √3 cot13° cot21° cot60° cot69° cot77° − 2(sin²41° + sin²49°)

**Formula used:**

sin(90 − θ) = cosθ, cot(90 − θ) = tanθ

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ sec33° / cosec57° = (1/cos33°) ÷ (1/sin57°)

⇒ = sin57° / cos33° = cos33° / cos33° = 1

⇒ cot13° × cot77° = cot13° × tan13° = 1

⇒ cot21° × cot69° = cot21° × tan21° = 1

⇒ Expression = √3 × 1 × 1 × cot60°

⇒ cot60° = 1/√3 ⇒ √3 × (1/√3) = 1

⇒ sin²41° + sin²49° = sin²41° + cos²41° = 1

⇒ −2(1) = −2

⇒ Total = 1 + 1 − 2 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles

sin(90 − θ) = cosθ, cot(90 − θ) = tanθ

Pythagorean Identity

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Standard Value

cot60° = 1/√3

Shortcut Tip

Pair complementary angles to simplify quickly

questions.question: The present age of Arman is four times the present age of his cousin, Riya. In 8 years, Arman's age will be three times Riya’s age at that time. What is Arman’s current age?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio: Arman : Riya = 4 : 1

Difference = 3 parts (constant)

After 8 years: (A+8) = 3(R+8)

Using ratio method → 4x + 8 = 3(x + 8)

**∴ x = 16 ⇒ Arman = 4x = 64**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Arman = 4 × Riya, After 8 years: Arman = 3 × Riya

**Formula used:**

Let Riya’s age = x, Arman’s age = 4x

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 8 years: Arman = 4x + 8

⇒ Riya = x + 8

⇒ Condition: 4x + 8 = 3(x + 8)

⇒ 4x + 8 = 3x + 24

⇒ x = 16

⇒ Arman = 4x = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Concept

Ratios can be converted into variables using x

Time Shift

Future age = Present age + years

Equation Method

Form equation from given condition and solve

Shortcut Tip

Use ratio + condition together for faster solving

questions.question: (1)/(30) { is what percentage of } (2)/(50)? { (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required percentage = (Value ÷ Base) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (1/30) ÷ (2/50) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (1/30) × (50/2) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (1/30) × 25 × 100 = 2500/30 = 83.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 83.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First value = 1/30

Second value = 2/50

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Part ÷ Base) × 100

 0 1/30 (83.33%) 2/50 (100%) 
• 
• 
• Required % = 83.33% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base value = 2/50 = 1/25

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/30) ÷ (1/25) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (1/30) × 25 × 100

⇒ Percentage = (25/30) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (5/6) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 500/6

⇒ Percentage ≈ 83.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 83.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change and Comparison

When asked "A is what percentage of B", A represents the part and B represents the base. The formula is (A ÷ B) × 100. Correctly identifying the base value is the most important step.

Fraction Division Rule

Dividing by a fraction is the same as multiplying by its reciprocal. For example: (A/B) ÷ (C/D) = (A/B) × (D/C). This property drastically simplifies complex fraction comparisons.

Common Fraction to Percentage Equivalents

1/2 = 50%, 1/3 ≈ 33.33%, 1/4 = 25%, 1/5 = 20%, 1/6 ≈ 16.67%, and 5/6 ≈ 83.33%. Memorizing these key values saves time during standard exam calculations.

x% of y = (x/100) × y

⇒ 20% = 20/100 = 1/5

⇒ 50% = 50/100 = 1/2

⇒ Equation: (1/5) × (1/2) × (5/9) × Number = 409

⇒ (1/18) × Number = 409

⇒ Number = 409 × 18

⇒ Number = 7362

**∴ The correct answer is 7362.**

questions.question: The sum of three numbers is 840. If the ratio of the second number to the first number is 3 : 13 and that of the third number to the second number is 8 : 12, then find the second number.
questions.solution:

Given ratios: B : A = 3 : 13 and C : B = 8 : 12 = 2 : 3

Make B common ⇒ B = 3k

Then A = 13k/3 × 3 = 13k, and C = (2/3) × 3k = 2k

Total = A + B + C = 13k + 3k + 2k = 18k = 840

**∴ k = 840 ÷ 18 = 46.67 ⇒ B = 3k = 140**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Sum = 840, B : A = 3 : 13, C : B = 8 : 12

**Formula used:**

Convert ratios to common form

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total = 13x + 3x + 2x = 18x

⇒ 18x = 840

⇒ x = 840 ÷ 18 = 46.67

⇒ Second number = 3x = 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

questions.question: Two trains started from station A to B with speeds of 68 km/h and 82 km/h on parallel lines. Find the distance (in km) between the two trains after 2.5 hours.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Same direction ⇒ distance = (difference of speeds) × time

Relative speed = 82 − 68 = 14 km/h

Time = 2.5 hours

Distance = 14 × 2.5

**∴ Answer = 35 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed₁ = 68 km/h, Speed₂ = 82 km/h, Time = 2.5 hours

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance by first train = 68 × 2.5 = 170 km

⇒ Distance by second train = 82 × 2.5 = 205 km

⇒ Difference = 205 − 170 = 35 km

**∴ The correct answer is 35 km.**

questions.question: Two trains, each 230 meters long, are running parallel to each other in the same direction. The speed of the faster train is 102 km/h and the speed of the slower train is 66 km/h. How long will it take for the faster train to completely pass the slower train?
questions.solution:

Same direction ⇒ Relative speed = 102 − 66 = 36 km/h

Total distance = 230 + 230 = 460 m

Convert speed: 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

Time = 460 ÷ 10

**∴ Answer = 46 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of each train = 230 m

Speeds = 102 km/h and 66 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 102 − 66 = 36 km/h

⇒ Convert to m/s = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

⇒ Total distance = 230 + 230 = 460 m

⇒ Time = 460 ÷ 10 = 46 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 46 seconds.**

questions.question: If the mean proportional of P and 169 is 104, then find the value of P.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional ⇒ √(P × 169) = 104

⇒ P × 169 = 104²

⇒ P = 104² ÷ 169

⇒ P = (104/13)² = 8² = 64

**∴ Answer = 64**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean proportional of P and 169 is 104

**Formula used:**

Mean proportional = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ √(P × 169) = 104

⇒ P × 169 = 104 × 104

⇒ P = 104² ÷ 169

⇒ P = 10816 ÷ 169

⇒ P = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

If x is mean proportional of a and b ⇒ x = √(ab)

If √x = y ⇒ x = y²

questions.question: A and B can complete a job in 18 days and 24 days, respectively. They worked together for 5 days, and then A left the job. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Total Work = LCM(18, 24) = 72 units

Efficiency of A = 72 ÷ 18 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of B = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of (A + B) = 7 units/day

Work done in 5 days = 7 × 5 = 35 units

Remaining work = 72 − 35 = 37 units

Time by B = 37 ÷ 3 = 12⅓ days

**∴ Answer = 12(1)/(3) { days} **
